preferences.longerLessons: On request; a five-minute lesson was requested and completed in this conversation
preferences.correctionStyle: Natural corrected sentence and at most one useful explanation

recordUpdates.exchangeDefinition: One learner reply and its tutor response
recordUpdates.refreshRemote: At lesson/chat start and immediately before a batch save
recordUpdates.betweenExercises: Use current conversation; no per-sentence repository reads or writes

proactiveInitiation.scope: Ordinary work chats across projects on this laptop
proactiveInitiation.firstPhrase: First suitable substantive work reply: offer a 30-60 second active practice unit
proactiveInitiation.format: One task-relevant learning objective and at most one optional production/recall prompt; feedback on actual attempts and later reuse
proactiveInitiation.source: Learner reports that one brief Spanish element is insufficient; increase substantive active practice across ordinary work chats
proactiveInitiation.verification: Saved instructions; adoption by other chats has not been observed

learningUnitCycle.review: Ask for recall before a model when reviewing familiar material
learningUnitCycle.production: At most one optional prompt per unit
learningUnitCycle.feedback: Natural corrected sentence and one useful explanation based on the actual attempt
learningUnitCycle.reuse: Revisit corrected patterns after intervening material
learningUnitCycle.progress: Occasional brief success, recurring correction and next target
learningUnitCycle.nonresponse: No backlog; later offer a fresh independent unit
learningUnitCycle.exposureOnly: An isolated translated phrase does not satisfy the active-practice preference

currentTopicRequest.topic: Practical imperatives for telling the assistant what to do
currentTopicRequest.source: Explicit learner request to study imperatives useful in daily interaction

progression: Work goals, requests, progress and completion
Present tense, questions, common verbs, ser/estar

reviewPolicy.mode: During suitable conversations; no reminders or background scheduling
priority: Previously successful patterns after a gap
New material when recall is secure

disclosureAuthorization.source: Explicit learner reply to the question asking permission for ongoing public updates without asking each time.
